about_the_game:
An endlessly playable jumping action game where you climb as high as you can using footholds.

In addition to simply constructed, attractive gimmicks and items,

the day and night system and graphics of the sky, clouds, Earth, and space are captivating.

You can climb as high as you want.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3 or AMD Ryzen™ 3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 7301 or NVIDIA GeForce 840M or greater
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows compatible audio device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5 or AMD Ryzen™ 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 or greater
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows compatible audio device
